description: This PHP class defines the LeaveEntitlementType entity for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_leave_entitlement_type' and includes properties for id, name, and editable status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementType
classes.description: Entity class representing leave entitlement types with properties for ID, name, and editability.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Returns whether the leave entitlement type is editable.

methods.name: setEditable
methods.description: Sets the editable status of the leave entitlement type.
